rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: Yesterday's ETH thesis broke, and it broke on the exact axis it was built on: FLOW. The Jul 16 ETF tape REVERSED the story — spot ETHER ETFs posted $28M of NET OUTFLOWS (Fidelity FETH -$11.2M, Grayscale ETHE -$4.8M, Grayscale ETH -$14.3M) while spot BITCOIN ETFs took in +$79.1M. The BTC inflow mix also got HEALTHIER: Fidelity and Bitwise together contributed $45.7M, more than half the day's total, so the bid is no longer a single-issuer BlackRock story — it broadened across three major issuers. Price confirmed the flow: over the last 24h ETH -2.39% vs BTC -1.01%, i.e. the coin we owned for 'relative strength' became the laggard and BTC became the leader. The whole complex is risk-off — global crypto cap -1.6% to $2.27T, Fear & Greed 27 (Fear), whale selling and oil/geopolitical risk in the tape. Today's CLARITY Act field hearing (House Financial Services, 10am ET, New York, 'Building the Future of Finance') is a real next-24h catalyst for the complex, but it is a promotional HOUSE field hearing and the actual bottleneck is the SENATE, where H.R. 3633 sits on the calendar with no floor vote scheduled, a shrinking window before August recess, and prediction-market odds COLLAPSED from the low-70s to ~43%. That asymmetry argues for owning the complex with the LOWEST beta to a disappointing/'sell-the-news' outcome while still participating if the hearing lands well. On a low-edge, Fear-tape day with no coin showing relative strength, the rules say favor the liquid majors — and BTC is the major that now owns the flow AND held its bid.
positions.driver: BTC is the correct all-in on a low-edge, risk-off day: it is now the flow leader (+$79.1M vs ETH -$28M on Jul 16) with a broadening, multi-issuer bid rather than a single-fund dependency; it is the 24h relative-strength leader among majors (-1.01% vs ETH -2.39%); and it carries the lowest beta into a binary catalyst whose real gate (the Senate) today's House field hearing does not move. Entry ~$63,241 sits in the $62,500-$63,000/$63,800-$64,000 support-and-demand shelf, so the setup is asymmetric: reclaiming $64,000 opens the $64,000-$65,000 resistance band and the EMA50 at ~$64,972, while structural support at $61,000 defines the invalidation. Runners-up rejected: ETH (~$1,839) — the flow story that justified owning it inverted outright, it is capped below the 100-day EMA at $1,943, and it is bleeding relative to BTC; SOL (~$74.81) — no fresh catalyst, softened again (-1.75%), and has failed this book twice by leading the bleed rather than the bounce; LINK (~$8.20, -2.8%), XRP (~$1.084, -2.0%), AVAX (~$6.48), DOGE (~$0.072), ADA (~$0.161) — all lower and none with an idiosyncratic catalyst; Cronos (+8%) — exactly the 'most volatile coin' chase the mandate forbids, illiquid relative to the majors and no definable stop into Fear. NOTE ON PRICING: the dashboard proxy first returned a CACHED response stamped asOf 2026-07-13 (ETH $1,781.40); a cache-busted re-pull returned the live asOf 2026-07-17T11:52:50Z. The stale quote was 3.2% off and would have materially mispriced the exit. All fills here use the verified-fresh feed.
positions.risks: BTC has slipped BELOW the $63,800-$64,000 support band and is trading in the $62,500-$63,000 demand zone — this is a buy into a level that is being tested, not defended from above, and a clean loss of $62,500 puts $61,000 structural support in play fast. Momentum is not confirming: RSI ~39.6 on one read (Sell signal, weakening buying strength) and ~49 on the daily (indecisive, sideways), with a bearish divergence flagged and heavy whale selling reported. The CLARITY hearing is a two-sided binary — a promotional House field hearing that does nothing for the ~43% Senate odds is a live 'sell-the-news' setup, and a stalled bill before August recess sours the whole complex. Fear & Greed at 27 means the tape has no cushion for a bad headline; oil/geopolitical shocks and any hawkish Fed re-pricing hit BTC directly. Owning the lowest-beta major also caps the upside — if the hearing lands well and risk rips, ETH/SOL outrun us. And the flow read is one session old: ETF flows are noisy day-to-day and could flip back to ETH as fast as they flipped away. Hard stop $58,181.54 (-8%) per the majors rule, set with wick room BELOW the $61,000 structural support that is the true thesis invalidation — if $61,000 fails on a closing basis the trade is wrong regardless of the stop.
